See also: pendrive and pen-drive

English

[edit]
English Wikipedia has an article on:
pen drive
Wikipedia

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • pendrive

Etymology

[edit]

A trademark for flash drives owned by Phison Electronics Corporation (US).

Noun

[edit]

pen drive (plural pen drives)

  1. (computing, chiefly Asia) A small electronic device used to store digital data, more portable and robust than a hard drive; a flash drive.
    Synonyms: see Thesaurus:USB flash drive
    • 2006 April, Juliane Viskup, Misdirection, Bloomington: Xlibris, →ISBN, page 92:
      After Peter finished checking the operating system setup, he carefully unscrewed his pen drive and plugged the USB connection into the computer.
    • 2008, Aminuddin Mahmud, “Branding - Mamak Style”, in Aminuddin Mahmud, editor, New Malaysian Essays, 2nd edition, volume 1, Kuala Lumpur: Mata Hari, →ISBN, page 60:
      So if you find yourself trapped in a pendrive/thumbdrive industry where everyone is basically making the same thing and copying patents whilst dishing out discounts, it's time to move on and separate yourself via a new identity.
    • 2009, James Floyd Kelly, “Netbook Hardware Options” (chapter 2), in Windows Netbooks: The Path to Low-Cost Computing, Berkeley, California: Apress, →ISBN, page 24:
      Pen drives have replaced the old floppy disks as the modern way to physically transport files from one computer to another. Yes, you can always email a file or burn it to a CD or DVD disc, but sometimes you just want to carry a copy of a file with you, and pen drives are so easy to use. You simply plug it into the USB port, and Windows treats it as just another storage location.
    • 2017, Ujjwala Walia, “The Timer Ticks” (chapter 5), in Zahana, Mumbai: BecomeShakespeare, →ISBN, unnumbered page:
      ‘What the fuck is this?’ Sen examined and almost laughed upon recognizing it. ‘A pendrive! A fucking pendrive! That's what the planter calls a bomb? Is he fucking kidding me?’
    • 2020, Reyhaan, chapter 8, in Secrets of the Lost Queen, Mylapore: Notion Press, →ISBN, unnumbered page:
      “If you don't mind, please give us the details in this pendrive,” I said, looking at his bald head.

Descendants

[edit]
  • → Hungarian: pendrive
  • → Portuguese: pen-drive, pen
  • → Polish: pendrive
  • → Spanish: pendrive

Translations

[edit]
flash drive — see flash drive
